title: POAP Book Club V2.0/Butterflies in Space
tagline: An NFT Book Club to help incentivize reading while also providing scalability metrics and community building to authors, libraries, schools and publishers.
description:
An NFT Book Club to help incentivize reading while also providing scalability metrics and community building to authors, libraries, schools and publishers.

I used EPNS, NFTPort, Polygon, Optimism, ENS, Unstoppable Domains, IPFS, NIftyKit, along with many more addition tools. this is a complete rebuild of my ETH NY 2022 Hackathon project and it was a solo project. 

Once i complete it, I would like tp pass it on to someone who would be able to give it life and keep it going so i can focus on creating more porjects to help make the world a better place as well as some stuff like accessible technology and create more hope for the future.

please see the Github project Notes and my submission video for additional details, as well as the many screenshots i took while creating this project!
